plugins.name: OpenBeats Gain
plugins.author: OpenBeats
plugins.description: A transparent, smoothed ±30 dB gain utility with stereo and mono layouts. The first-party proof that OpenBeats plugins can ship as native VST3 and CLAP bundles.
plugins.notes: Install in a VST3 or CLAP host such as Bitwig, REAPER, Ardour or Carla. OpenBeats 1.0.0 browses and downloads plugins but does not host them yet.
